Title: Azure Monitor SQL insights for Azure SQL in public preview

Body.Content: Azure Monitor SQL insights offers you a flexible canvas for telemetry collection, analysis, and rich custom visualization. The new interactive experiences with SQL insights let you customize telemetry collection and frequency, and also combine data from multiple sources into a single monitoring experience for your entire SQL estate. SQL insights is built on top of the Azure Monitor platform, giving customers access to the native alerting and visualization functionality. SQL insights is enterprise-ready and easily scales to meet your resource requirements. This feature is available in preview for SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.
